metadata.conversion: Estimated hourly kWh from timestamp-weighted integration of active power in watts. Each reading is held until the next reading; first/last values extend to the hour boundary. Retain hours with at least 118 of 120 nominal 30-second samples (>=98.3%), no gap over 60 seconds and boundary gaps at most 60 seconds. Retain complete IST days. Original dates and measured power preserved; no scaling or injected anomalies.
